prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the side-impact collision at the intersection referenced in your file. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is now receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

Within the next fifteen days, please provide a written statement of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you confirm the insured's contact information so that we may serve any further notice required.

Please ensure that all evidence relating to this loss is preserved. This includes recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, total loss valuations, claim notes, and any dashcam or intersection video in your possession. Destruction or alteration of such material could prejudice our client's rights, and we expect your cooperation in keeping it intact while the claim is evaluated.
